subject.title: feat: add Google Cloud Run sandbox provider

question: Should Crabbox support Cloud Run sandboxes in core as a preview delegated-run provider with a shared-secret remote gateway and an in-container direct mode?
rationale: The remaining decision is not mechanical: it establishes a new supported provider, a remote command-execution trust boundary, and an operator support commitment beyond the narrow environment-variable repair.

options.title: Sponsor the provider after repairs
options.body: Accept the preview provider direction, require the documented environment URL path and changelog cleanup, then review the gateway contract as a supported security boundary.

options.title: Keep it external for now
options.body: Decline a built-in provider until Cloud Run sandboxes and the gateway contract are mature enough for a maintained core integration.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the provider after repairs
recommendation.body: Accept the preview provider direction, require the documented environment URL path and changelog cleanup, then review the gateway contract as a supported security boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor has the clearest available implementation and live-operation context; final acceptance still requires a repository maintainer sponsor.
